policies.target: not X but Y / contrast constructions
policies.reason: Review the function of the negation; stock rebranding can substitute for an argument.
review_contexts: Repeated interchangeable contrast across adjacent drafts
exceptions: Neti-neti that identifies what is being relinquished
Necessary disagreement, literal correction and precise technical negation

policies.target: soul / spirit / God → field / coherence / architecture
policies.reason: Automatic recoding changes meaning and may introduce unsupported physical claims.
exceptions: Author-declared adapted usage with a stated distinction

policies.reason: Separate ontological reduction, material description and practical use of matter; record the precise premise under review.
review_contexts: Unspecified labels such as materialism is wrong

policies.reason: The intended sense needs to remain legible.
review_contexts: Sliding between feeling, symbolic principle and physical quantity
exceptions: Attributed alchemical principle or declared metaphor

policies.reason: Technical terminology cannot validate an unrelated spiritual or philosophical claim.
review_contexts: Borrowed scientific authority without mechanism or source
exceptions: Actual physics discussion supported by the cited source

policies.reason: Review outcome guarantees and guru framing rather than ban a token.
exceptions: Specific bounded description supported by evidence

rule: A policy records a reason, sense and context. It is not a global search-and-replace table.
